signal.description: LiteLLM and Trivy supply-chain malware incidents exposed multi-cloud credential sprawl as a systemic vulnerability, potentially reframing Azure's security-first positioning as a structural competitive advantage.

judgment.assessment: The LiteLLM/Trivy malware pattern is not an isolated incident — it exposes a structural vulnerability in multi-cloud credential management. Azure's integrated security stack (Entra ID, Defender for Cloud) positions it to capture security-motivated cloud consolidation spend.

action.directive: WATCH whether the LiteLLM/Trivy malware pattern reframes multi-cloud credential sprawl as a structural Azure positioning opportunity.
action.target: azure vs aws vs gcp cloud market share competitive dynamics

falsifier.condition: Azure cloud revenue share declines below 23% for two consecutive quarters despite the security narrative, or AWS launches an equivalent integrated credential management solution within 6 months.
